nodes.label: Required Skill Routing
nodes.rationale: Routes specialized work through Impeccable, Supabase, Postgres Best Practices, Graphify, browser control, Imagegen, and OpenAI Docs so implementation follows domain-specific governance.

nodes.label: Server Mutation Boundary
nodes.rationale: Server Actions are preferred for first-party mutations while explicit HTTP concerns use Route Handlers, keeping authentication, validation, and authorization server-side.

nodes.label: Secret Content Non-Inference
nodes.rationale: Secret state must remain absent from shared parents, projections, logs, notifications, search, realtime, and caches to prevent indirect disclosure.

nodes.label: Dream Plan Experience Memory Our Story Loop

nodes.label: Privacy Is Behavior
nodes.rationale: Hidden information must be unqueryable rather than merely hidden in the interface.

nodes.label: Idempotency and Concurrency Contract
nodes.rationale: Durable keys, locks, unique constraints, or versions enforce logical once-only outcomes and invariants rather than unsafe check-then-insert flows.

nodes.label: Wishlist Purchase Secret Separation
nodes.rationale: Purchaser-only rows are structurally separated so owner-readable records and projections cannot reveal purchase existence or state.

nodes.label: ADR-001 Multi-Tenant Couple Ownership
nodes.rationale: Separate users, couples, and memberships provide a uniform couple_id boundary while allowing future membership policy changes.

nodes.label: ADR-002 Dream-to-Memory MVP
nodes.rationale: The first release proves the connected product mechanism without making security-heavy integrations a launch dependency.

nodes.label: ADR-005 Database-First Authorization
nodes.rationale: RLS and Storage policy remain the final isolation layer, with server authorization as workflow defense in depth.

nodes.label: ADR-006 Purchaser State Separation
nodes.rationale: Separating purchaser state reduces inference exposure across queries, aggregates, events, search, exports, and DTOs.

nodes.label: ADR-007 Protected Vault Not E2EE
nodes.rationale: The service may process plaintext, so product claims must not promise end-to-end or zero-knowledge protection.

nodes.label: ADR-008 Pre-Build Brief Post-Build Design System
nodes.rationale: Design tokens and components should document visually verified shipped truth rather than speculative rules.
nodes.norm_label: adr-008 pre-build brief post-build design system

nodes.label: Expand-Migrate-Contract Deployment
nodes.rationale: Backward-compatible staged schema evolution preserves application rollback safety and avoids blindly reversing production data transformations.

nodes.label: Shared Journal Experience Thesis
nodes.rationale: The interface should combine consumer-utility clarity with private-keepsake warmth and avoid feeling like pink project-management software.

nodes.label: Mobile Is Designed Not Compressed
nodes.rationale: Navigation, calendars, forms, media, and dialogs require purpose-built narrow-screen behavior.

nodes.label: Private External Event Default
nodes.rationale: A connected calendar belongs to its owner; partner-visible details require explicit sharing and otherwise expose nothing or an optional busy placeholder.

nodes.label: Explicit Calendar Conflict Policy
nodes.rationale: Bidirectional changes must not silently overwrite edits; provider identifiers, idempotency, and surfaced conflict behavior protect user intent.

nodes.label: Content-Safe Observability
nodes.rationale: Operational signals use safe correlation metadata while excluding private content, credentials, URLs, and media paths.

nodes.label: Public and Secret Environment Key Separation
nodes.norm_label: public and secret environment key separation

nodes.label: Cross-Tenant Deterministic Demo Seed
nodes.rationale: Two fictional couples plus private and secret records make isolation and non-disclosure tests reproducible without real personal data.

nodes.label: Traceability Coverage Gate
nodes.rationale: A requirement counts as covered only when behavior, delivery assignment, and verification are all named.

nodes.label: Protected Access Not Zero Knowledge
nodes.rationale: Private storage and temporary unlock controls protect access, but service infrastructure can still process plaintext.
